name: Envelope Distortion
bom_parts_summary: LM324 op-amp, BC337 transistor, 1N4148/1N5819 diodes, 500k mix pot
components_evidence: BOM lists only part values/refdes (e.g. '680pf (2) - C3, C4', 'LM324 (1) - U1', 'BC337 (1) - Q1'); no package or mounting style (THT/SMD/0805/DIP/TO-92/etc) is stated anywhere on the page.

lineage.credit: I'm positive this is based on someone else's circuit design... It was likely cobbled together from snippets of distortion circuits and envelope followers.
